limits: AttachChip and halt can disturb the USB host's timing/state
No reset, flash, Program::ReadMemory, GetChipInfo, or peripheral writes
DMI loads use x5/x6 and progbuf0/1; save, restore, and verify before resume
Resume and detach attempted on every ordinary error; disconnected probe or killed process can prevent cleanup
Underlying USB API may block despite bounded DMI polling
Does not stop live control applications; operator must do preflight
uid_verification: not performed; independent identity evidence required
